speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: Today, telecom operators, as part of network and service resilience requirements, must provide adequate redundancy, back-ups and diversity arrangements within their networks.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: But outages still occur even with robust measures in place.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: In addition, we are studying alternative means to enhance back-ups in our networks so that consumers can continue to have connectivity during outages; as well as how telecom operators can enhance their capabilities to quickly identify and rectify the causes of disruption.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: IMDA is working with EDB to ensure that data centre investments in Singapore are energy efficient.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
text: The Government remains committed to our goals under the Paris Agreement.
